content: कुण्डः, -डी, -डम् [<ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Uṇ. 1. 112</ls>] .²1 A bowl-shaped vessel, a basin, bowl. .²2 A round hole in the ground for receiving and preserving water. बलं नागसहस्रस्य यस्मिन्कुण्डे प्रतिष्ठितम् <ls>Mb. 1. 128. 68</ls>. .²3 A hole in general; अग्निकुण्डम्. .²4 A pool, well; especially one consecrated to some deity or holy purpose. .²5 The bowl of a mendicant. .²6 A water-jar (कमण्डलु). .{@-डः@} .({@-डा@} {%f.%}) A son born in adultery, the son of a woman by a man other than her husband while the husband is alive; पत्यौ जीवति कुण्डः स्यात् <ls>Ms. 3. 174</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 22</ls>. .{@-ण्डा@} An epithet of Durgā.
